test_title: PYST 49: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A man spends 72% of his salary and saves Rs. 5,740 per month. What is 10% of his annual salary (in Rs.)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Savings % = 100% − 72% = 28%

28% of monthly salary = Rs. 5,740

1% of monthly salary = 5,740 ÷ 28 = Rs. 205

10% of annual salary = 1.2 × monthly salary (since 10% of 12 months = 1.2 months)

Required value = 1.2 × 100 × 205 = 120 × 205 = Rs. 24,600

**∴ The correct option is B.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Spend = 72% | Monthly Savings = Rs. 5,740

**Formula Used:**

Salary = Expenditure + Savings | Annual Salary = Monthly Salary × 12

Spend (72%)Save (28%)
28% = Rs. 5,740Monthly Salary (100%)

⇒ Monthly Savings % = 100% − 72% = 28%

⇒ 28% of Monthly Salary = 5,740

⇒ 1% of Monthly Salary = 5,740 ÷ 28 = 205

⇒ Monthly Salary = 205 × 100 = 20,500

⇒ Annual Salary = 20,500 × 12 = 2,46,000

⇒ 10% of Annual Salary = 2,46,000 × 10/100 = 24,600

**∴ The correct option is B.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Change Formula

Percentage Change = (Final Value − Initial Value) ÷ Initial Value × 100

Salary Distribution

Income is always taken as 100%. If a person spends x% and saves y%, then x + y = 100.

Annual Conversion

Annual Salary = Monthly Salary × 12. To find p% of Annual Salary, use (p/100) × 12 × Monthly Salary.
